page.overview:
Who is Clayton Gentlebreeze?

"Clayton grew up in an RV park on the Monterey Coast. He's a traveler by nature, so touring with his favorite races fits his lifestyle beautifully. He doesn't see himself ever settling down in one spot, not for longer than a weekend anyway. He just can't ignore the call of the open road."
